scientific_integrity.basis: Self-contained degree-imbalance proof, exact source-sink paths, Fibonacci identity; two finite computational checkers.
scientific_integrity.mathematical_claim: For every integer n >= 2 the minimum length of a circular binary word covering all linear length-n words avoiding 00 is Lucas(n+1)-1, and an optimum itself avoids 00.
scientific_integrity.scope: Binary cyclic overlapping windows covering every linearly 00-avoiding n-word, n >= 2.
scientific_integrity.verification_limits: Checks through n=12 are finite tests, not substitutes for the infinite proof; no external assessment or historical-priority certification.

title: A sharp Lucas-number cyclic covering theorem for Fibonacci words
